subject: Support hiring at Quartzdesk
body:
Hi Priya,

Quartzdesk posted a Customer Success Manager role on 2026-10-28. Teams growing support often start by taking repetitive tickets off the queue. SupportPilot automatically resolves up to 45% of inbound tickets for teams handling more than 5,000 tickets per month. Would a short call next week be useful?
